newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Astra says vehicle sales up.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Astra says vehicle sales up.

text.p: Indonesia's largest automotive maker PT Astra International said on Monday the company's total vehicle sales increased to 32,696 units in November from 30,219 units in October.
Astra said in a monthly statistical report passenger car sales rose by 18.8 percent to 3,613 units in November from 3,042 units in October and compared with 3,284 units in November last year.
A total of 554 commercial vehicles were exported last month, compared with 472 units in October.
Astra said commercial car sales increased by 6.8 percent to 28,529 units in November from 26,706 units in October.
Total vehicle sales, including exports, in the first eleven months of this year totalled 299,885 units compared with 353,812 units in the same period of last year.
The report said total motorcycle sales, including exports, fell to 139,272 units in November from 143,575 units in October.
During the first eleven months, total motorcycle sales, including exports, were 1,268,328 units. Astra did not provide comparative data.
